description: This file defines the `IdempotencyStoreFilter` class, a servlet filter used to manage idempotency for HTTP requests within the Fineract framework. It intercepts requests, extracts idempotency keys, and conditionally stores command results to prevent duplicate processing.

classes.name: IdempotencyStoreFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that manages idempotency keys for HTTP requests, ensuring safe duplicate request handling by storing command results based on configured conditions.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Overrides the `doFilterInternal` method to process requests, extract idempotency keys, invoke subsequent filters, and store command results if conditions are met.

methods.name: extractIdempotentKeyFromHttpServletRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the idempotency key from the request header based on the configured header name from `FineractProperties`.
